Buy a rice ball at the convenience store
Go into Hibari Mart, find the right item on the shelf, buy a rice ball and pay in Japanese.
Choose the right item to buy
Find and pick up a rice ball
Today you came to buy a rice ball and a drink. Look around the store.
The fridge has water, tea and juice. You find the label that says 「水」 (water).
What do you need to buy today?
Today's task is to buy a rice ball. Please look on the shelf.
Yes, a rice ball. They're on that shelf over there.
The shelf shows the flavours: ume (pickled plum), sake (salmon), konbu (kelp).
You put a salmon onigiri in your basket.
Sorry, you mean 「袋は要りますか」, right? I understand.
That will be 497 yen in total.
Could you say that once more, please?
Yes. Four hundred and ninety-seven yen.
No, it's 497 yen. Please listen again.
Yes, I've received the exact amount.
Thank you very much. Please come again.
You take the receipt and leave the store. What do you say?
Summary: "~ wo kudasai" (~, please), "~ wa irimasu ka" (do you need ~?), "~ de onegaishimasu" (pay by ~). Remember to read labels carefully before choosing!
